name: weighted plate 45 degrees side bend
description: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.
